_notes.announce.tier: A fragment with a LEADING SPACE, spliced mid-sentence into the sub messages. Keep the leading space and keep the word Tier in English.
_notes.announce.tierParen: A fragment with a LEADING SPACE, appended after the verb. Keep the leading space.
_notes.announce.sub.streak: A fragment with a LEADING COMMA AND SPACE, appended mid-sentence before the tier fragment.
_notes.announce.saidMessage: Has a LEADING SPACE and is appended to a preceding sentence. {subject} is a pronoun fetched per viewer (he/she/they/neopronoun). Use {g} to inflect the verb: it is he, she, or other.
_notes.announce.redemption.input: {text} is the already-built announcement; this only joins it to the viewer's message.
_notes.announce.yt.superchat: Ends with a colon and a TRAILING SPACE; the viewer's message is appended after it.
_notes.announce.yt.superchat.amount: Ends with a colon and a TRAILING SPACE; the viewer's message is appended after it.
_notes.announce.pronoun.subject: The subject pronoun used when a viewer's pronouns are unknown. English uses the singular they.
_notes.emoji.wrap: Wraps an emoji description read aloud, e.g. '(fire emoji)'. {description} is a noun phrase.
